answer: Bind each account to a dedicated 500 GB NVMe drive audited by random 4 MB read probes every 30 minutes (2% of daily I/O). Verifiers sample uncached blocks across a trellis of flash sectors and demand a drive-signed reply in 5 ms from each hardware vault; one honest node locks 2,500 POA once, whereas 100 fakes cost 250,000 POA and 100 physical drives. Spreading a vine of clones onto one shared disk spikes tail latency above 5 ms and slashes 100% of stake, though this fails if a drive vendor leaks root signing keys.
